tools.name: token-check
tools.description: Pre-trade token & memecoin verdict OK/CAUTION/AVOID/UNKNOWN for EVM and Solana: honeypot sell simulation, taxes/transfer fee, mint/freeze/blacklist authority, DEX liquidity & pair age; every flag sourced (GoPlus, honeypot.is, RugCheck, DexScreener). Fails closed: no data -> UNKNOWN Price: $0.01 per

tools.name: token-check-batch
tools.description: Batch of up to 10 token-check verdicts in one call (EVM + Solana, mixed): OK/CAUTION/AVOID/UNKNOWN per token with sourced flags, taxes, liquidity, plus a summary count. Same checks as token-check at a fifth of the per-token price; for scanners and trading loops Price: $0.02 per call, USDC on Base vi

tools.name: validator-analyzer
tools.description: Ethereum validator health verdict: slashing, status, balance-vs-effective -> HEALTHY/CAUTION/AVOID Price: $0.02 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: wallet-risk
tools.description: Wallet risk verdict from OFAC SDN mirror + ScamSniffer scam-database + GoPlus malicious-address DB + explorer profile -> ALLOW/REVIEW/BLOCK, every flag with provenance Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: airdrop-score
tools.description: Airdrop eligibility score for an address + calibrated expected value of the opportunity (sybil-rejection and token-decay adjusted) Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: transfer-route
tools.description: Cheapest open network to move a coin from exchange A to exchange B: withdraw/deposit open, fee, minimums, memo, ETA, congestion; same-ticker-different-contract traps flagged Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: wallet-status
tools.description: Is deposit/withdraw of a coin open right now, per network on bitget, gate, htx, kucoin + last-30-day notices from bitget, kucoin, okx (suspend/delist/migration) -> OPEN/PARTIAL/CAUTION Price: $0.02 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: ticker-collision
tools.description: Same ticker = same token everywhere? Contract per chain on bitget, gate, htx, kucoin + price vs median on bitget, gate, htx, kucoin, mexc, okx -> CONSISTENT/DIVERGENT/COLLISION (anti-scam before deposit/arbitrage) Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: funding-snapshot
tools.description: Perp funding of a coin now on bitget, gate, kucoin, okx: rate, interval, annualized, mark/index basis where published, cross-venue spread. Market data only Price: $0.005 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: leverage-calc
tools.description: Max safe leverage for a perp trade: liquidation >=1.5x beyond stop (never off), costs vs move, risk per trade, measured survival cap, exchange limit -> min with the binding constraint named Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: news-propagation
tools.description: Does news about coin X move Y? Measured 30-day hourly return correlation anchor vs related perps (not narrative: ETH->LINK strong, NVDA->RENDER weak) -> PROPAGATES/ISOLATED + per-link strength Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: defi-pool-apy
tools.description: Real APY/TVL from DefiLlama for any protocol/pool. Quick screening Price: $0.02 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: srt-verify
tools.description: Verify subtitles/timing (QC), pure-logic Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: synesthetic-av

tools.name: harmony-grade
tools.description: Color grade derived from harmony/tonal center (Scriabin CoF<->color, prisms.db) Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: x402-ping
tools.description: x402 payment-flow test: the cheapest real paid call ($0.001 USDC) to verify an agent's wallet/client end-to-end before wiring paid tools. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
